description: Poorly processed bitter cassava releases cyanide and can cause konzo, sudden permanent paralysis of the legs. #shorts #nature #plants #didyouknow
script: A staple food can paralyze your legs in a single day. Bitter cassava roots are full of chemicals that release cyanide. script: On Guam, a paralyzing disease may have come from eating bats. After World War Two, the Chamorro people had an ALS-like illness at rates up to a hundred times normal. script: In 1960, over a hundred thousand turkeys in England died of a mystery disease. Vets called it Turkey X. Birds lost energy, their wings drooped, and their livers were destroyed. script: A painkiller nearly wiped out India's vultures. In the 1990s, farmers gave cattle a drug called diclofenac. When the cattle died, vultures ate the carcasses. The drug destroyed their kidneys.
